SELECT IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, IT.DESCRIPTION_LOC, IT.SPECIFICATION, IT.UNIT_MEASURE, ST.STC_SELLER_PRICE, IT.MAKER_NAME, IT.ORIGIN_CODE , ST.AVAIL_QTY FROM ICOMBYIT IT, WMSSTCK ST WHERE IT.BUYER = ST.ORG_WAREHOUSE_CODE AND IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = ST.STDCATLG_ID AND ST.PROCESS_TYPE = '1' AND IT.STATUS <> 'D' AND ST.STATUS <> 'D' AND ST.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code_fr} AND ST.AVAIL_QTY > 0
AND IT.DESCRIPTION_LOC LIKE '%' || #{st_desc} || '%'
AND IT.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || #{st_spec} || '%'
AND IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_item_no} || '%'
ORDER BY IT.DESCRIPTION_LOC, IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO
